title: InvSqrt LR schedule wrong scheduler chosen for OLMoE3 — Cos used where WSD intended
root_cause: OLMoE3-3B-27B used CosWithWarmup with only warmup_steps configured. Without an explicit decay schedule the optimizer ran cosine decay from peak lr to alpha_f over the full training horizon, instead of the WSD (warmup-stable-decay) schedule the recipe intended. The lr trajectory was silently cosine-shaped instead of WSD-shaped.
invariant: WSD-style training recipes must use the WSD scheduler with explicit warmup, decay step counts, and decay_fraction=None — not CosWithWarmup, even though both yield monotonic lr curves.
diff_summary: Replace CosWithWarmup(warmup_steps=2000) with WSD(units=SchedulerUnits.steps, warmup=2000, decay=int(50e9 / GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE), decay_fraction=None).
silent_check: Buggy scheduler runs without any error — the trainer uses the cos-with-warmup lr at every step, training proceeds with finite gradients and updates; only the lr trajectory is silently wrong.
